name: Web Scraping
when_to_use: Extraction of unstructured data from HTML pages (text, tables); not a statistical technique in itself, but a collection step before any analysis.
notes: Depends on internet access at run time — not a code failure.

expected_input.question: How to extract structured data from HTML pages?

plain_explanation.purpose: Automatically collects information published on web pages.
plain_explanation.when_to_use_plain: When the data is on a website and there is no ready download.
plain_explanation.data_needed: Addresses (URLs) of the pages and the description of the section to collect.
plain_explanation.example: Download news from a portal for later analysis.
plain_explanation.diagram: web page -> program reads the text -> organized table
